'''Peej''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] member of [[the Shroud's syndicate]]. During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], he was stationed at [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]]'s hidden base on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], where he was confronted and killed.
